title: About SecureKit
description: SecureKit offers free, privacy-first password and developer tools that run in your browser.
body:
SecureKit is a set of free browser-based tools for checking and generating passwords and for everyday developer tasks such as hashing, Base64 and UUIDs.

How it works

Nearly every tool runs locally using your browser's built-in Web Crypto API. The one exception is the breach check, which sends only the first five characters of a SHA-1 hash to the Have I Been Pwned range service.

What we do not claim

No tool can guarantee security. Scores and crack-time figures are estimates. Use a password manager and multi-factor authentication alongside these tools.

Try the password generator or contact us.
